name: Indianapolis Motor Speedway

official.map_publisher: Indianapolis Motor Speedway (facility map, PDF page rendered to PNG)

select.only_ways_note: Pinned to the ways of the verified lap so the drawing regenerates identically.

verify.notes: The IMS oval (two equal straights, two equal short chutes, four equal turns) is mirror-symmetric, so the mirrored fit is as good as the direct one; orientation follows the map compass (north to the left).

notes: Ways of OSM relation 20573682 "Indianapolis Motor Speedway 2026". Brickyard 400 runs on the oval (https://www.indianapolismotorspeedway.com/events/brickyard: "returns to the famed Indianapolis Motor Speedway oval"; 2026 race: 160 laps of the 2.5-mile oval). The INDYCAR outline is stylised (stretched ~10%), so the IMS facility map is the reference. The oval is 180-degree symmetric: rendered with rotate -90.8, equivalent within 0.6% to the map-compass orientation +89.2.
